value.signature: fn verify_package (input : PackageInput , verifier : & impl PackageVerifier) -> Result < VerifiedPackage , PackageError >

review.body: { verify_causes (& input) ? ; if ! verifier . published_package (& input) { return Err (PackageError :: Binding) ; } Ok (VerifiedPackage { input }) }
review.item_premise: Package verification reads full public marker and act carriers, effective constants, writing prices and a declared deterministic public binding verifier. Structural equality does not substitute for published binding evidence. Inputs, immutable checked results and distinct refusals remain public; no secret or canonical encoding enters this operation. Observation supplies no verification premise. The unchanged structural checks are factored into verify_causes, which candidate verification also calls; the publication verifier still executes separately after all structural checks.
